integrity: Proof and computational inputs explicitly separated; finite computations are corroboration, not an infinite proof. The published H4 root-flat counts are not claimed as independently novel.
scientific_limitations: Only rank-one coefficients of the defining two-dimensional spin representation are treated; counts of two-dimensional H4 root flats used for the binary icosahedral case were already published. Neither full Fourier-rank-two spectra across all irreducible blocks nor independent originality verification is asserted.
title: Spinor coefficient zero sets and projective rigidity across finite binary polyhedral groups
